robert-garcia.text: Voted No on H.R. 1 (One Big Beautiful Bill Act), motion to concur in the Senate amendment, July 3, 2025; passed 218-214.

source.title: House Roll Call 190, H.R. 1, July 3, 2025 (Clerk of the House)

robert-garcia.text: July 15, 2026: "Today, I am voting yes on an amendment to block $3.3 billion in American taxpayer dollars for Benjamin Netanyahu and the Israeli military."
With Rep. Lisa McClain (R), passed the Common Cents Act (July 2026) to end penny production and let businesses round cash transactions to the nearest nickel.
Announced a $544,904 federal DOT grant (Aug 31, 2026) to replace Long Beach water taxi engines for cleaner, faster service.
As Oversight ranking member (Sept 21, 2026): "ICE must immediately put an end to this inhumane treatment and give us answers"; co-led letters on conditions at Florida ICE facilities.

source.title: Ranking Members Garcia, Thompson, Frost Demand Answers From ICE (Oversight Democrats)

robert-garcia.text: Led creation of an Immigration Enforcement Dashboard (Nov 2025) tracking potential misconduct, and released a Feb 2026 report on killings by federal immigration agents in Minneapolis.

source.title: Ranking Members Garcia, Thompson, Frost Demand Answers From ICE (Oversight Democrats)

robert-garcia.text: Site lists priorities including abortion access, gun violence prevention, healthcare expansion, affordable housing, wage increases, green jobs and LGBTQ+ protections.
Campaign positions: healthcare is a human right and Medicare for All the primary solution; $15 minimum wage and stronger union protections.
Campaign positions: transition away from fossil fuels, expand clean energy, back the Green New Deal framework.
Campaign positions: universal background checks, assault-weapon ban, age restrictions on firearm purchases.
Campaign positions: codify abortion rights into federal law; expand pathways to citizenship for undocumented residents; opposes restrictions on vote-by-mail.

brian-burley.text: Campaign pledge: "Advocate for Tax Relief to Families and Business Owners."
Campaign pledge: "Take a Stand Against Illegal Immigration."
Campaign pledge: "Fully Support Our Law Enforcement and Our Military"; wants stronger coordination between federal and local law enforcement.
Campaign pledge: "Fight to Restore American Family Values."
Seeks to reduce federal regulations that increase housing and energy costs; opposes "stronger regulations on pollution and carbon emissions" while supporting cleaner-technology innovation.
Supports requiring proof of citizenship for voting in federal elections and wants to prevent prolonged ballot counting.
On the school board he says he has stood for "parental rights, academic excellence, and fiscal responsibility."
Says he wants to prevent abusive deepfakes involving students and teachers through coordination with school districts.
Supports a strong, well-funded military while opposing "endless wars."

notes: Burley: no positions found on health care, housing policy detail, guns, abortion, or labor; endorsements page not retrievable (BallotReady lists none). Garcia and Burley issue-position items marked from smarter.vote come from an aggregator summarizing campaign/official material.
